questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Deakin University is a bit far out of the city, so try to live close to a train or tram station, if you are not planning on renting a car ;)

Additional comments:
questions.answer: the on campus housing did not seem nice. No pots, pans, linen, anything. AND no grocery store close to campus
